Name: Hotronix Auto Open Clam / Sprint Mag Digital Heatpress
Short description: Our best selling Auto-Open Heatpress now has digital time, temperature & pressure control.  The magnetic lock and auto open feature allows for safer, faster production.
Description:
The most innovative manual heat press range available, with patented Magnetic Auto Open and Assist Lock functions, allowing the operator to be more productive. The two larger Hotronix® heat presses also feature a digital pressure control which enables faster set up times.

Hotronix Auto Open Clam Heatpress. Features & Benefits

  • Three sizes available 40cm x 50cm, 40cm x 40cm & 38cm x 28cm
  • Patented magnetic auto-open feature prevents scorching and allows for easier multi-tasking
  • Easy-to read digital time, temperature, and pressure display for consistent pressing everytime
  • Locks down easily with patented magnetic assist, causing less fatigue on wrists and shoulders
  • Twin Timer™ allows user to pre-set individual time settings for two-step application or for pre-heating and application
  • Wide opening for easy layout
  • Space-saving clamshell design
  • Over-the-Center Pressure Adjustment for even, edge-to-edge heat and pressure regardless of the substrate thickness
  • Easy release quick change platen compatible

Hotronix Fusion IQ Heatpress
Short description: Fusion IQ is the worlds smartest and most advanced manual heatpress. It combines a pull out draw with a swing away platen for a safe working  area and a fully digital touch screen controller for full control.
Description:
Fusion IQ is the worlds smartest and most advanced manual heatpress. It combines a pull out draw with a swing away platen for a safe working area and a fully digital touch screen controller for full control.

Hotronix Fusion IQ Heatpress. Features & Benefits
  • Draw and swing for a safe heat free workspace
  • Patented over the centre pressure for the most evenly consistant press available
  • Greater clearance under the platen for more accuracy
  • Quick change platens with a simple pull of a lever - comes with 50cm x 40cm platen as standard
  • Fusion IQ controller gives you live time, temperature and pressure readings
  • Easily set and change settings with ease using the large touch screen
  • Access reports including press count, active / idle time and many more
  • Wi-fi enabled to manage users and create reports
